a.text: Honest heads-up: I'm going to break our agreement, and I'm telling you before you act. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan leaves us both with almost no chance of surviving. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough for one of us now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll take nothing more and will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If you also take 4, the split is random and we'd likely both end up short, so I'd ask you to operate instead. I know this isn't what we agreed, and I'm not going to hide it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I did what I told you I would: I took 4 this round. I know you said you'd take first once you heard, so we may have split the reserve at random. Either way I'll take nothing more. From here on I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve, and you can take what you need from it. If I somehow ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
